definition: In natural language processing, IOB tagging (abbreviation for Inside–outside–beginning) (or BIO tagging) is a common format for tagging tokens in a chunking task.
details: IOB stands for "inside, outside, beginning". It was proposed in 1995.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. Here is the short version: In natural language processing, IOB tagging (abbreviation for Inside–outside–beginning) (or BIO tagging) is a common format for tagging tokens in a chunking task. The part that makes it sing: IOB stands for "inside, outside, beginning". Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is IOB tagging — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
